standard-dialogue-entering-scaperune.npc: Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.

standard-dialogue-entering-scaperune.player: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!

standard-dialogue-entering-scaperune.npc: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.

options.text: But I want to leave now.

steps.npc: Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.

steps.text: The player leaves the prison through the east hallway.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-pop-a-ba.npc: You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-prison-pete.prompt: What would you like to say?

steps.npc: Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.

steps.player: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!

steps.npc: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.

steps.player: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!

options.text: How do I get out of here?

steps.player: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-other-th.npc: No thanks, I don't want that just now.

standard-dialogue-pulling-the-lever-for-.npc: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.

standard-dialogue-popping-a-balloon-anim.npc: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.

standard-dialogue-popping-a-balloon-anim.text: The player goes to Prison Pete and hands him the key.

standard-dialogue-popping-a-balloon-anim.npc: Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...

standard-dialogue-popping-a-balloon-anim.text: If the player popped the wrong animal:

steps.npc: Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.

standard-dialogue-popping-a-balloon-anim.text: If the player popped the correct animal:

steps.npc: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-pop-a-ba.npc: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!

standard-dialogue-after-unlocking-the-la.npc: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!

standard-dialogue-after-unlocking-the-la.player: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-pop-a-ba.npc: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-leave-th.npc: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-drop-ite.npc: Oi! No dropping stuff in the exit! Chuck it somewhere else!

standard-dialogue-leaving-through-the-ex.text: You quickly escape the prison with Pete.
The player is teleported back to where they were.

standard-dialogue-leaving-through-the-ex.npc: Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:

standard-dialogue-talking-to-prison-pete.npc: Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
